_meta.note: Scraped via Claude-in-Chrome from the live GBP. These are REAL reviews. The grid currently on /reviews is fabricated placeholder copy and should be replaced with these. Reviews marked complete:true have full text; complete:false were truncated by Google's 'More' and need re-capture before use.

reviews.author: Patrick Janzen
reviews.text: Always love working with Greylyn Wayne Staging! They're always so professional, and do a phenomenal job at making our staged houses look amazing. 🏡

reviews.author: Joan Medlen
reviews.text: Is this MY home? Greylyn Wayne did an amazing job showcasing the best of our home in the areas requested. After living in a home you love for 26 years, it is so heart-warming to see it staged with care. With your good work, we are putting our best foot forward! Thank you!

reviews.author: Tony Fargason
reviews.text: We had the good fortune to work with Tori. She furnished our entire apartment — she is incredibly skilled at making good use of small spaces. She is creative and responsive. And she is frugal. I only regret that I don't have another project to let her complete for us!!

reviews.author: Patricia Schaub
reviews.text: We were so pleased with Alicia's choices and recommendations of the custom design plans and execution. Our time was limited and her design and execution was spot on.

reviews.author: kayla davila-elrite
reviews.text: Greylyn Wayne exceeded all expectations. Their team was professional, easy to work with, and incredibly talented. They brought out the best in the space with thoughtful, stylish touches that felt both elevated and welcoming. …

reviews.author: Jake Grant
reviews.text: I have used Greylyn Wayne for a number of stages for my listings, they have always done a great job but I was especially thrilled with my last experience with their team and wanted to share it with those considering stagers.
